children: JGB futures rise in the morning Tokyo session, buoyed by the recent decline in crude oil prices. This could help cool inflationary pressures in Japan and ease worries that the BOJ could quicken the pace of its rate increases. Risk sentiment has improved following a rebound in AI-related stocks overnight, say Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley Securities fixed income strategists. However, concerns persist regarding the possibility of a slowdown in AI investment exerting downward pressure on the economy, or leading to an easing of inflationary pressures and shifts in capital supply and demand, they say in a commentary. The benchmark 10-year JGB futures are higher by 0.28 yen at Y127.28. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
